sections.Profile:
The "Time Warp" pinball machine, released by Williams in September 1979, features a mythology and world history theme. Designed by Barry Oursler with artwork by Constantino Mitchell and Jeanine Mitchell, this solid-state electronic game includes two flippers, five pop bumpers, two kick-out holes, and multiple drop target banks. Notably, many units of "Time Warp" were equipped with distinctive banana-shaped flippers, adding a unique twist to gameplay.
